app.subsol: All sizes are in mm. Always check with your cutting service whether they want the finished size or the raw size.
app.platatest: Test payment — the {driver} driver is active, no money is charged.

landing.sub: Enter the cabinet sizes, see it in 3D with every part at its real thickness, and get the cutting list with both the finished size (with edging) and the cut size (without edging). All sizes are in mm.
landing.gratuit1: Unlimited cabinets, saved to your account
landing.gratuit2: Full 3D view, with exploded layout and part selection
landing.gratuit3: Finished sizes (L × W) and piece counts
landing.gratuit4: Warnings: shelves too long, doors too wide, runners that do not fit
landing.platit1: Cut sizes (finished minus edging, on each side)
landing.platit2: Edging on every edge: L1 · L2 · l1 · l2
landing.platit3: CSV export for the cutting service
landing.platit4: The cabinet stays editable after payment
landing.cum1: Enter L × H × D, the board thickness and the edging.
landing.cum2: Choose doors, shelves, drawers and the back type.
landing.cum3: Check the cabinet in 3D and review the finished sizes.
landing.cum4: Unlock the cutting list for that cabinet.
landing.exempluTitlu: What comes out, on a real cabinet
landing.exempluSub: Base cabinet {W} × {H} × {D} mm, {pal} mm board, {gros} / {subtire} mm banding. The sizes below are worked out right now, by the same engine that produces the shop’s jobs.
landing.hartiiTitlu: The sheets that go to the shop
landing.hartiiSub: Every order prints ready to work from, not as a table you still have to cut up by hand.
landing.limbiTitlu: It speaks the language of the workshop
landing.limbiSub: Thirty languages, in workshop words, not translated out of English with a dictionary.

eroare.cerere: The request could not be completed.

credit.alimentat: Your credit has been topped up.
credit.insuficient: You do not have enough credit for a new cabinet ({pret} RON). Top up below and try again.
credit.unCorpCosta: A cabinet costs {pret} RON — that is enough for {n} cabinets.

credit.driverStripe: You will be taken to Stripe Checkout. Credit is added only once the payment is confirmed.

comenzi.goalaText: An order holds the material (board and edging), the cabinets and, at the end, the lists you send to the workshop: cutting, assembly and CNC.

corpuri.platit: Your payment has been recorded. The cutting list is unlocked for that cabinet.
corpuri.goalaText: Press “+ New cabinet” and pick a model from the catalogue: kitchen units, wardrobes, chests of drawers, bathroom units. Then change the sizes as you need.
corpuri.duplicaTitlu: A copy is charged like any new cabinet
corpuri.notaPret: The full cutting list costs {pret} RON per cabinet. A duplicated cabinet is a new cabinet and is charged separately.
corpuri.confirmaStergere: Delete the cabinet “{nume}”? This cannot be undone.
corpuri.eroareStergere: The cabinet could not be deleted.

modele.intro: Start from the closest model and then change the sizes. Every model below is a configuration the calculator produces in full — the dimensions are the usual ones, not fixed.
modele.materialDinComanda: The material comes from the order: {pal} mm board, {gros}/{subtire} mm edging.
modele.faraCredit: You do not have enough credit. Top up to add a cabinet.
modele.creeazaDupaModel: Create a cabinet from this model
modele.corpGolDesc: Start from the standard kitchen base unit and change whatever you like.
modele.limiteTitlu: What the calculator cannot generate yet
modele.limita1: Drawers in corner cabinets — use a straight cabinet next to it instead.
modele.limita2: Drawers in a cabinet with a partition — they are figured across the full cabinet width; put the drawers in a cabinet without a partition.
modele.limita3: Sliding doors, framed glass doors, tambour shutters.
modele.limita4: Plinth, legs, worktop — these are calculated separately from the cabinet.
modele.limita5: Cut-outs for sinks, hobs, sockets or appliance recesses.
modele.limita6: Top box (the unit above a wardrobe) — make it as a separate cabinet.
modele.limiteNota: If you need something from this list, tell me which — it can be added to the calculation engine.

bucatarie-jos.descriere: Units under the worktop, usually 720 mm high and 560 mm deep.

living.descriere: Wardrobes, bookcases, chests of drawers, TV units.

atipic.descriere: Drawn from sides and angles: each side becomes a panel, and the back and front are cut to the outline. All parts go to the CNC after cutting.

colt.descriere: For the corner between two walls. The top, bottom and shelves are cut as a bounding rectangle and then routed — the cut-out sizes are in the parts list.

bucatarie-inalt.descriere: Tall cabinets that stand on the floor, on a plinth.

baza-2usi.descriere: The standard unit under the worktop, with one internal shelf.

baza-1usa.descriere: The narrow version, to fill out the run.

baza-3sertare.descriere: Equal fronts over the full height, boxes on ball-bearing runners.

baza-sertar-usa.nume: Base unit with drawer and door
baza-sertar-usa.descriere: A cutlery drawer on top, a door below.

baza-chiuveta.descriere: No shelf, so there is room for the trap and the plumbing.

baza-nisa.descriere: An open box for an oven or a dishwasher. Check the recess the manufacturer asks for.

sus-2usi.descriere: A tall wall unit with two shelves.

sus-1usa.descriere: The narrow version, with two shelves.

sus-hota.descriere: A bridging unit above the extractor hood or the fridge.

sus-raft.descriere: No doors, one shelf. Thick edging on every visible edge.

dulap-2usi.descriere: A bedroom wardrobe with four shelves. Above 2000 mm the doors need a fifth hinge, so the height stops here; for more, add a separate top box.

dulap-3usi.descriere: No shelves: at this width they would need a centre post, which the calculator does not generate yet.

biblioteca.descriere: A tall unit without doors, with four shelves.

comoda-4sertare.descriere: Equal fronts, boxes made from 16 mm board.

noptiera.descriere: A small unit with two equal drawers.

corp-tv.descriere: A low, wide unit with two doors. The doors reach the 600 mm width limit.

baie-lavoar.descriere: No shelf, to leave room for the trap. Surface-mounted hardboard back.

baie-coloana.descriere: A tall, narrow unit with four shelves and one door.

colt-jos-L.descriere: The classic corner unit under the worktop, with two fronts coupled on a bi-fold hinge. No shelf: at this span it would sag, use a carousel instead.

colt-jos-diagonal.descriere: A single diagonal front, about 450 mm wide. The inside stays reachable across the full width.

colt-jos-orb.descriere: A rectangular unit whose neighbour covers 550 mm of the front. The easiest to cut: every part stays a rectangle.

colt-sus-L.descriere: A corner wall unit with two fronts and two shelves.

colt-sus-diagonal.descriere: The version with a single diagonal front and two shelves.

colt-living-deschis.nume: Open corner unit for the living room
colt-living-deschis.descriere: A tall corner unit without doors, with four L-shaped shelves. Works well as an end shelf unit too.

colt-baie.descriere: A small corner unit with one shelf and a diagonal front.

atipic-sub-scara.descriere: A trapezoid with a low right-hand side and a slope rising to the left. Change the sides and angles to match your staircase.

atipic-mansarda.descriere: Five sides: the top follows the roof pitch, with a straight section.

atipic-liber.descriere: Start from a rectangle and add or move the sides as you need.

colt-dressing.descriere: A tall corner unit for a dressing room or bedroom, with two fronts and three shelves.

biblioteca-usi-jos.descriere: Open shelves above, two doors across the bottom.

piesa-simpla.descriere: L1 and L2 are the long edges, l1 and l2 the short ones. Banding on the long edges takes off width, banding on the short ones takes off length.

baza-2usi-soclu.descriere: Stands straight on the floor, no legs: the sides go all the way down and a plinth goes in front.

baza-4sertare.descriere: Four shallow drawers, for cutlery and small things.

baza-ingusta.descriere: 200 mm wide, for the gap left at the end of a run.

sus-2usi-1000.descriere: Tall, almost to the ceiling, with three shelves.

coloana-camara.descriere: Floor to top, five shelves and full-height doors.

coloana-matura.descriere: Narrow and tall, with a single shelf at the top.

etajera-cuburi.descriere: A 4×4 grid of cubes, from uprights and shelves.

bufet.descriere: Low and wide, with a middle upright and four doors.

dulap-pantofi.descriere: As deep as a shoe laid sideways, with three shelves.

coloana-cuptor.descriere: Door below, an opening in the middle for the oven, door above. Check the opening the maker asks for.

coloana-frigider.descriere: An opening from the bottom for the fridge, with a door above. Check the opening the maker asks for.

dulap-glisant.descriere: The doors do not swing out, so it fits a tight bedroom too.

dressing-glisant.descriere: Three sliding doors and four compartments, for a whole wall.

comandaNoua.intro: You choose the main material now; you can add as many others to the order as you like (fronts in a different decor, drawer boxes in white board, and so on).
comandaNoua.dataAutomata: The order date is filled in automatically, with today's date.
comandaNoua.notaCant: Thicknesses not stocked for the chosen decor stay selectable, just marked “to order”. Thick banding goes on the edges that show and get handled, thin banding where there is little wear.
comandaNoua.notaFormate: The optimiser picks the combination with the least waste on its own and tells you at the end how many whole sheets you need, including the pieces cut out of them.

fero.intro: Choose the system now, before the cabinets: it drives both the quantities in the hardware list and the drilling dimensions for every part.
fero.intrebareBalama: Which hinges go on the doors?
fero.intrebareGlisiere: Which runners go on the drawers?
fero.intrebareSuspensii: Are wall units fixed with cabinet hangers?
fero.suspensiiDetalii: {n} per cabinet, {kg} kg per pair. Without them, cabinets are fixed with visible brackets.
fero.notaSchimbare: Changing this recalculates the quantities and drilling dimensions of every cabinet in the order. Do it before you send the parts to be cut.

minifix.descriere: Can be taken apart at any time. Each joint: one cam and two dowels.

confirmat.descriere: A fixed joint, cheaper. The screw head stays visible and is covered with a cap.

cepuri-suruburi.descriere: The simplest. The screws show on the outer side panel, so only for cabinets that are hidden.

blum-clip.descriere: With soft close built into the hinge. Ø35 cup, 13 mm deep.

universal.descriere: An ordinary hinge with a 35 mm cup. The damper is fitted separately, on the cabinet.

fara.descriere: Open cabinets, or another front system.

bila.descriere: A chipboard box, with the runner fixed to the side of the box and to the side of the cabinet.

tandem.descriere: The runner sits under the box, out of sight. It needs a notch in the bottom of the box.

suspensii.descriere: Concealed behind the back panel, adjustable for height and depth.

nota.taiereLaUnghi: cut at {a}° on one end and {b}° on the other (45° mitre on a right angle); the size is on the outer edge
nota.dupaContur: cut to the outline of the cabinet
nota.dupaConturCuRost: cut to the outline of the cabinet, reduced by the {rost} mm reveal
nota.unaPeBrat: one at the end of each arm
nota.panouPentagon: pentagon: from the {a}×{b} rectangle, cut the corner at 45° (legs {ca} and {cb}); diagonal edge {diag} mm, edge-banded
nota.panouL: L-shape: from the {a}×{b} rectangle, cut out the {ca}×{cb} corner; edging on the two front edges
nota.politaPentagon: pentagon: from the {a}×{b} rectangle, cut out the {ca}×{cb} corner; edging on the front edges
nota.politaL: L-shape: from the {a}×{b} rectangle, cut out the {ca}×{cb} corner; edging on the front edges
nota.nutSpate: groove {off} mm from the back, {ad} mm deep
nota.balamaleBrat1: {n} hinges, {cot} crank; can be coupled to door 2 with a bi-fold hinge
nota.balamaleUsaOrb: {n} hinges per door, {cot} crank; {orb} mm blind area, covered by the neighbouring cabinet
nota.socluInFata: at the front, between the sides — the bottom rests on it

avert.politeAtipic: Shelves are not calculated automatically for non-standard cabinets: add them as separate parts.
avert.sertareColt: Drawers are not calculated for corner cabinets; use a straight cabinet next to it.
avert.politaColtLata: Corner shelf with sides over 800 mm: use 25 mm board or an extra support.
avert.usaDiagonalaLata: Diagonal door wider than 600 mm: fit two fronts or reduce the sides.
avert.zonaOarbaPreaMare: The {orb} mm blind area covers the whole front: reduce it or widen the cabinet.
avert.fronturiSertarPreaInalte: The drawer fronts exceed the height of the cabinet.
avert.usaLata: Door wider than 600 mm: risk of warping and heavy load on the hinges.
avert.usaInalta: Door over 2000 mm: use 5 hinges or split the front.
avert.balamaCot0: Overlay door on a single cabinet: normally a 0 crank hinge.
avert.balamaCot18: Inset door: normally an 18 crank hinge.
avert.glisieraNuIncape: The {lg} mm runner does not fit the {dint} mm internal depth.
avert.cutiePreaInalta: The drawer box is taller than the front.
avert.politaLunga: {lung} mm shelf: over 800 mm, 18 mm board sags; use 25 mm board or a centre post.
avert.conturDeschis: The outline does not close: {eroare} mm are left over. The angles add up to {suma}°, but {laturi} sides need {ceruta}°.
avert.conturPreaPutineLaturi: An outline needs at least three sides.
avert.adancimePreaMare: A depth of {d} mm is too much for sides of {a} and {b} mm: no corner is left to cut.
avert.frontAltPal: “{corp}”: the fronts are {front} mm board, but the geometry is calculated with the carcass thickness ({corpMm} mm).
avert.jocGlisiera: “{corp}”: the drawer boxes are calculated with {jg} mm clearance per side, but {glisiera} needs {cerut} mm. Change the clearance on the cabinet or the runner on the order.
avert.compartimentIngust: The compartment comes out {lat} mm: too narrow for a shelf. Remove a partition or widen the cabinet.
avert.usiPesteMontant: {usi} doors across {comp} compartments: one door would land on a partition. Use a multiple of {comp}.
avert.sertareCuMontant: Drawers are not split by partitions: they are still calculated across the full cabinet width.
avert.usiPesteInaltime: Doors of {cerut} mm asked for, but only {incape} mm fit: they were made full height.
avert.usiJosFaraPolita: Doors only at the bottom, with no shelf: add at least one, otherwise the door has nothing to close against at the top.
avert.usiPeCompartimenteFaraMontant: You picked compartments for the doors, but the cabinet has no partition: the doors were made across the full width.
avert.usaPreaIngusta: Compartment {comp} has no room for that many doors: none came out there.
avert.sertareNuUmplu: The drawer fronts do not reach the bottom: {gol} mm is left open below. Set the front height to {front} mm to fill the cabinet.
avert.piesaPreaMica: A side under 20 mm: check the sizes.
avert.piesaLatimeMaiMare: The width ({lat}) is larger than the length ({lung}): when cutting, the length is the long side. Swap them if the grain has to run the other way.
avert.socluNuMerge: A plinth only works on a straight cabinet built “between”. Here it was left out.
avert.socluPreaInalt: A {soclu} mm plinth on a cabinet this short: only {ramane} mm left inside.
avert.nisaPreaMare: A {nisa} mm opening does not fit: above {incape} mm there is no room left for the door on top.
avert.politeFixeInPlus: You asked for {cerut} shelves, but the cabinet needs {fac}: those edge the opening and hold the doors.
avert.politeNuIncap: {cate} shelves have nowhere to go: the opening took the whole space.
avert.glisantaSingura: One sliding door has nothing to slide past. Put at least two.
avert.glisantaNuIncape: The sliding doors do not come out: the cabinet is too small for the tracks and the overlap.
avert.glisantaLata: A {lat} mm sliding door is wide: it sags in time and jumps the track. Make it from two, or use an aluminium frame.
avert.glisantaInalta: A {inalt} mm sliding door is tall: it needs a frame, not a plain chipboard panel.
avert.glisantaFaraZone: Sliding doors run the full height: the lower-door height and the opening are ignored.
avert.glisantaFaraCompartimente: Sliding doors run past the uprights, so they cannot be put on chosen compartments.

print.subsol: All sizes are in mm and are the cut size (without edging) unless stated otherwise. Check with your cutting service which size they want.
print.notaPlaci: The boards are calculated with a real nesting run (guillotine cuts, 4 mm blade), not from surface area.
print.notaAdaos: The {pct}% allowance on the edging covers losses during application and the ends of the roll.
print.notaDebitare: The figures in the Cut columns are cutting sizes. Edge banding is glued to one edge and thickens the piece across it: banding on the long edges (L1/L2) reduces the width, banding on the short edges (l1/l2) reduces the length. Thin banding does not change the cutting size. The Finished column is the size after banding.
print.cantFrontale: edging on the front edges — see the CNC drawing
print.rezumatMaterial: {m2} m² of parts · waste {deseu}% · the sheet nesting is on a separate sheet
print.atentieCnc: Note: {n} positions need machining after cutting (corner cut-outs, 45° cuts, grooves). They are marked “CNC” in the notes, and the dimensioned drawings are on the separate machining sheet.
print.faraCncText: This order has no parts that need machining after cutting: everything is cut straight, on the panel saw or the band saw.
print.notaCnc: The parts below are cut to the bounding size (the rectangle in the table) and only then machined. The drawings are dimensioned in mm, seen from above, with the corner facing the walls at the bottom left. The red lines are the edges that get edge-banded after machining.
print.notaIncadrare: Parts nested into sheets, with guillotine cuts and a 4 mm blade. Every part is labelled with its code from the cutting list. The hatched areas are the offcuts worth keeping.
print.coliDeCumparat: Sheets to buy: {n} — broken down by material below.
print.neplasate: {n} parts did not fit into the chosen formats: they are larger than the sheet. Check the dimensions.
print.notaColi: A whole sheet is {w} × {h} mm. Halves and quarters are cut from it, which is why the “sheet equivalent” can have decimals while “to buy” is rounded up.
print.notaAnsamblu: Room {A} × {B} × {H} mm. The cabinets are butted end to end; each one's distance is measured from the starting corner of the wall, and the height from the floor to the bottom of the cabinet.
print.notaGoluri: Gaps are closed with filler panels or by adjusting a cabinet. A gap under 40 mm is usually solved with a fillet strip, not a new cabinet.
print.notaMontaj: One sheet per cabinet: its parts, the finished and cut sizes, and the hardware needed. The hardware quantities are estimates, worked out from how the cabinet is built.
print.pasCant: Apply the edging to the marked edges, then trim the excess.
print.pasGauri: Drill for {sistem}: sides to bottom and top.
print.pasPolite: Drill for the shelf supports, at the heights you want.
print.pasCarcasa: Assemble the carcass and check the diagonals before tightening.
print.pasSpate: Fix the back — it is what keeps the cabinet square.
print.pasSertare: Fit the runners and drawer boxes, then adjust the fronts.
print.pasUsi: Fit the hinge cups and the doors, then adjust the gaps.
print.pasSuspensii: Fit the hangers behind the cabinet and the rail on the wall, then adjust vertically.

ansamblu.legendaPlan: The numbers are the positions from the order. Wall units are drawn with a dotted outline. The starting corner of each wall is the bottom left one.
ansamblu.notaPozitie: The distance is measured from the starting corner of the wall, and the height from the floor to the bottom of the cabinet. For base units the height is 0 (or the plinth height).

editor.platit: Your payment has been recorded. The cutting list is unlocked for this cabinet.
editor.conturTitlu: The cabinet outline, seen from the front
editor.conturHint: Work side by side: give the length of the side and the angle at the corner where it meets the next one. The outline is right when it closes. The first side runs to the right.
editor.conturRezumat: Bounding size {W} × {H} mm, {laturi} sides, angles add up to {suma}°.
editor.conturRamas: {mm} mm are left over. For {laturi} sides the angles must add up to {ceruta}°, and they now add up to {suma}°.
editor.conturLungimeRea: Side {n}: the length must be between 10 and 4000 mm. The contour was not saved.
editor.conturUnghiRau: Side {n}: the angle must be between 1 and 359°. The contour was not saved.
editor.conturAdaugat: Added a {mm} mm side. Adjust the angles.
editor.notaColtOrb: An ordinary rectangular cabinet: only the front is narrower, because the rest stays covered by the neighbouring cabinet.
editor.notaColtL: The top, bottom and shelves are not rectangles: cut the bounding rectangle from the list, then rout the corner according to each part's note. Drawers are not calculated here.
editor.notaAtipic: Each side of the outline becomes a panel as deep as the cabinet, mitred at both ends. The back and the front are cut to the outline. All parts go to the CNC.
editor.salvareAutomata: Changes are saved to your account automatically.
editor.legenda3d: board face · thick edging · thin edging · raw edge (no edging) · hardboard.
editor.legenda3dManuire: Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, tap a part for its sizes.
editor.nuSaCopiat: The CSV could not be copied.
editor.blocatText: The finished sizes and the 3D view are free. The cut sizes (finished minus edging) and the edging on each edge are unlocked for this cabinet.
editor.legendaCant: thick banding on the visible edge · thin banding · no banding. L1/L2 = long edges, l1/l2 = short edges. Banding on the long edges reduces the width, banding on the short edges reduces the length.
editor.formulaBalamale: Hinges by height: ≤900 → 2, ≤1600 → 3, ≤2000 → 4, above → 5. Ø35 cup, 3–6 mm from the edge, 80–100 mm from the ends.
editor.formulaSertar: Drawer: W_box = W_int − 2×{jg}; box front/back = W_box − 2×{ts}; runner length ≤ D_int, in 50 mm steps.
editor.formulaTaiere: Cut: the length loses the banding on the short edges, the width the banding on the long edges. {cg} mm banding takes {rg} mm, {cs} mm banding takes {rs} mm.
editor.fara3d: The 3D view could not load (the 3D library is blocked). The parts list works normally.
editor.apasaPiesa: Tap a part to see its sizes. Every part is drawn at its real thickness; the edge colours show the edging.
editor.notaInaltimeUsi: empty = doors over the full height; a value = doors only at the bottom, like a bookcase
editor.notaMuchiiPiesa: L1 and L2 are the long edges, l1 and l2 the short ones. Banding on the long edges takes off width, banding on the short ones takes off length.

cont.notaFoaie: What you fill in here goes at the top of the sheets that leave for cutting. Whoever cuts the board has a number to call when a dimension does not fit.
cont.notaEmail: The e-mail cannot be changed here. Write to us from the message box if it needs changing.

stat.intro: The constants in this app were measured in a real workshop, not taken from books. For other countries we have no measurements — here we count what people actually build, from the cabinets they have saved.
stat.goalaTitlu: No cabinet has been saved yet.
stat.goalaText: The measuring starts with the first one. Nobody is asked anything — the constants come with the cabinet.
stat.verdict: People here work in {unitate}. That is measured, not assumed.
stat.preaPutine: Too few dimensions to say anything. They add up on their own as cabinets get saved.
stat.neclar: The numbers say neither one clearly. Better nothing than an invented answer.
stat.coteNota: These are typed by hand every time, so they are real evidence. Workshops are counted, not cabinets: one workshop with forty cabinets of 800 is one person, not a country habit.
stat.constanteAvertisment: A value left as it came is not a measurement — it is our own default read back. Only the "other" column says anything.
